% pgfplots oracle fixture (hand-written): mark repeat, mark phase, mark
% indices, mark options scale, fill and fill opacity, draw=none, line widths.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[every axis plot post/.append style={semithick}]
\addplot+[mark repeat=3, mark phase=2, domain=0:10, samples=11] {x};
\addplot+[mark indices={1,4,...,10}, mark=diamond*, mark options={scale=1.4}, domain=0:10, samples=11] {10-x};
\addplot[fill=blue!30, fill opacity=0.5, draw=red, line width=1.2pt] coordinates {(2,2) (5,8) (8,2)};
\addplot[draw=none, mark=*, mark size=1.5pt] coordinates {(1,5) (3,5) (5,5)};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
